title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
world_rules: This is the wizarding world of Harry Potter, set in 1991-1992 Britain.
Magic is real but governed by strict rules — wands channel magic, spells require incantations and intent.
Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry has four houses: Gryffindor, Slytherin, Ravenclaw, and Hufflepuff.
The Dark wizard Lord Voldemort was defeated ten years ago when his Killing Curse rebounded off baby Harry Potter.
Harry is famous in the wizarding world as 'The Boy Who Lived' but has no memory of these events.
Muggles (non-magical people) are unaware of the wizarding world.
The Philosopher's Stone (Sorcerer's Stone) can produce the Elixir of Life and turn any metal into gold.
A Horcrux-like fragment of Voldemort's soul is unknowingly attached to Harry, giving him a lightning-bolt scar.

nodes.prose: A tabby cat sits on a brick wall at Number 4 Privet Drive, reading a map. As night falls, an old man in sweeping purple robes appears at the end of the street. Albus Dumbledore clicks the Put-Outer, and every streetlamp on the road goes dark. He addresses the cat: 'I should have known you'd be here, Professor McGonagall.'
character_states: Dumbledore has arrived at Privet Drive
McGonagall has been watching the Dursleys all day
established_facts: location = 4 Privet Drive, Little Whinging, Surrey
time = night, November 1st 1981
The Put-Outer can extinguish streetlamps

choices.text: Wait for Hagrid to arrive with baby Harry

nodes.prose: A low rumbling sound breaks the silence. A huge motorcycle falls out of the sky and lands on the road. Rubeus Hagrid, an enormous man with a wild black beard, climbs off Sirius Black's flying motorcycle. In his massive arms, wrapped in blankets, is a sleeping baby with a fresh, lightning-bolt shaped cut on his forehead. 'Little tyke fell asleep as we was flyin' over Bristol,' Hagrid sniffles.
character_states: Harry is a baby with the scar
established_facts: Harry survived the Killing Curse
Voldemort's curse left a scar
Sirius Black lent his motorcycle
Harry's parents James and Lily Potter are dead

choices.text: Dumbledore places Harry on the Dursleys' doorstep

nodes.prose: Ten years pass. Harry Potter now sleeps in the cupboard under the stairs at Number 4 Privet Drive. His cousin Dudley — fat, spoiled, and cruel — has two bedrooms. Aunt Petunia raps on the cupboard door. 'Up! Get up! Now!' It's Dudley's birthday. Harry must cook breakfast and stay out of trouble.
established_facts: Harry has been abused and neglected for 10 years
Harry wears Dudley's oversized hand-me-downs
Harry has round glasses held together with tape

choices.text: Go to the zoo for Dudley's birthday

nodes.prose: At the zoo, Harry finds himself alone in front of a large boa constrictor exhibit. He leans against the glass and sighs. 'I know how you feel,' he tells the snake. 'Stuck behind glass, everyone gawking at you.' The snake raises its head and winks. Harry jumps — the snake is communicating with him. It nods toward a small sign: Bred in Captivity. 'That's me too,' Harry whispers.
character_states: Harry doesn't know this is unusual
established_facts: Harry is a Parselmouth
The snake is a boa constrictor from Brazil

choices.text: Watch as the glass vanishes and the snake escapes

nodes.prose: Dudley shoves Harry aside to see the snake. Harry hits the floor — and something strange happens. The glass vanishes. The boa constrictor slides out, pausing by Harry. 'Brazil, here I come. Thanksss, amigo.' Dudley stumbles backward into the enclosure as the glass reappears, trapping him inside. Uncle Vernon's face turns purple with rage. Harry is locked in his cupboard for a week.
established_facts: Harry performed accidental magic
Harry doesn't understand what happened

choices.text: Weeks later, the Hogwarts letters begin arriving

nodes.prose: A letter arrives for Harry — addressed in emerald-green ink to 'Mr. H. Potter, The Cupboard Under The Stairs.' Vernon snatches it away. More letters come. Then dozens. Then hundreds, pouring through the mail slot, shot from the chimney, tucked inside eggs. Vernon boards up the house, but on Sunday — 'No post on Sundays!' — letters pour through the fireplace like a blizzard. Vernon snaps.
character_states: Harry is desperate to read a letter
established_facts: Hogwarts is trying to contact Harry
Address was impossibly specific
Letters are enchanted to find Harry

choices.text: Vernon drags the family to a shack on a rock in the sea

nodes.prose: The shack is miserable. Rain hammers the walls. Dudley is asleep. Harry lies on the floor, drawing a birthday cake in the dust. He watches Dudley's watch tick to midnight. July 31st. 'Make a wish, Harry,' he whispers to himself, and blows. BOOM. The entire door is smashed flat. A giant of a man fills the doorframe, his face nearly hidden by a wild tangle of hair and beard.
established_facts: location = shack on rock in the sea
time = midnight, July 31st

choices.text: Hagrid reveals the truth about Harry's identity

nodes.prose: 'Yer a wizard, Harry.' Hagrid hands him the crumpled Hogwarts letter. Harry learns he has been accepted at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Vernon tries to stop it — 'I will not pay for some crackpot old fool to teach him magic tricks!' Hagrid points his pink umbrella at Dudley. A pig's tail bursts from Dudley's backside. 'I'd appreciate it if yeh didn't tell anyone at Hogwarts about that,' Hagrid says. 'Strictly speakin', I'm not allowed ter do magic.'
established_facts: Hagrid was expelled from Hogwarts
Hagrid's wand is hidden in his umbrella
Harry's parents didn't die in a car crash — they were murdered

choices.text: Travel to London for Diagon Alley

nodes.prose: Hagrid leads Harry to a tiny, grubby pub called the Leaky Cauldron, invisible to Muggles. Inside, the pub goes silent. Then everyone swarms Harry — shaking his hand, bowing, crying. A pale young man in a turban stutters forward: Professor Quirrell. 'P-p-pleased to m-meet you, P-Potter.' He can't seem to meet Harry's eyes. Hagrid leads Harry through to the back alley and taps a specific brick with his umbrella. The wall rearranges itself into an archway.
established_facts: Harry is a celebrity in the wizarding world
Quirrell is the Defense Against the Dark Arts professor
Quirrell wears a turban
The Leaky Cauldron is the gateway to Diagon Alley

choices.text: Enter Diagon Alley

nodes.prose: Diagon Alley takes Harry's breath away. Cauldron shops, owl emporiums, stacks of spell books, potion ingredients, broomsticks in windows. They visit Gringotts — the wizard bank run by goblins — where Harry discovers his parents left him a fortune in Vault 687. Then Hagrid retrieves a grubby little package from the high-security Vault 713. 'Hogwarts business,' he says gravely. 'Very secret.'
established_facts: Harry's parents left him gold
Vault 713 contained a small package
Gringotts is the safest place in the world — besides Hogwarts

choices.text: Get fitted for robes at Madam Malkin's

nodes.prose: At Madam Malkin's Robes for All Occasions, Harry meets a pale, pointed-faced boy already being fitted. 'Hogwarts too?' the boy drawls. He talks about broomsticks, his father's influence, and how he thinks they 'shouldn't let the other sort in.' Before Harry can respond, the boy leaves. He never gives his name. Harry feels immediately uneasy.
character_states: Harry met Draco Malfoy without knowing his name
established_facts: Draco is prejudiced against Muggle-borns
Draco's family is wealthy and influential

choices.text: Visit Ollivanders for a wand

nodes.prose: Ollivanders is dusty and ancient. The old wandmaker appears silently. 'I wondered when I'd be seeing you, Mr. Potter.' Wand after wand fails — until one. Holly and phoenix feather, eleven inches. Warmth surges through Harry's fingers. Red and gold sparks shoot from the tip. Ollivander goes pale. 'Curious... very curious. The phoenix whose tail feather is in your wand gave another feather — just one other. It is curious that you should be destined for this wand, when its brother gave you that scar.'
character_states: Harry's wand is the brother of Voldemort's wand
established_facts: Harry's wand = holly, phoenix feather, 11 inches
Voldemort's wand shares the same core
The phoenix is Fawkes (Dumbledore's phoenix)
Ollivander remembers every wand he's sold

choices.text: Hagrid buys Harry a birthday present

nodes.prose: While Harry stares at the wand shop window, Hagrid disappears into Eeylops Owl Emporium. He returns with a beautiful snowy owl in a cage. 'Happy birthday, Harry.' It's the first real birthday present Harry has ever received. He names her Hedwig, after a name he found in A History of Magic.
character_states: Harry has his first-ever birthday present
established_facts: Hedwig is a snowy owl
Owls deliver wizard mail

choices.text: Head to King's Cross Station for Platform 9 3/4

nodes.prose: Harry stands between platforms 9 and 10 at King's Cross. His ticket says Platform 9 3/4. That doesn't exist. He's about to panic when he hears a plump red-haired woman say, 'Packed with Muggles, of course...' She shepherds her children toward the barrier. Harry watches a freckled boy run straight at the brick wall — and vanish. 'Excuse me,' Harry asks. 'Could you tell me how to—?' 'How to get onto the platform? Not to worry, dear. Ron's new too. Just walk straight at the barrier.'
character_states: Molly Weasley is kind to Harry
established_facts: Platform 9 3/4 is accessed by running at the barrier between platforms 9 and 10
The Weasleys are a large, warm wizarding family

choices.text: Board the Hogwarts Express

nodes.prose: The scarlet steam engine pulls away. Harry finds a compartment and is joined by Ron Weasley. Ron has a smudge on his nose and a hand-me-down rat named Scabbers. Harry buys the entire trolley of sweets — Chocolate Frogs, Bertie Bott's Every Flavour Beans, Pumpkin Pasties. Ron's eyes go wide. Harry gets his first Chocolate Frog card: Albus Dumbledore. 'So THAT'S Dumbledore!' The card mentions Nicolas Flamel. A bushy-haired girl appears at the door: 'Has anyone seen a toad? A boy named Neville's lost one. I'm Hermione Granger, by the way.'
character_states: Ron is Harry's first real friend
Neville has lost his toad Trevor
established_facts: Scabbers is Ron's rat
Nicolas Flamel is mentioned on Dumbledore's Chocolate Frog card
Hermione has already memorized her textbooks
Ron's family is poor but loving

choices.text: Arrive at Hogwarts by boat across the Black Lake

nodes.prose: 'Yeh'll get yer firs' sight o' Hogwarts in a sec,' Hagrid calls over his shoulder. They round a bend and — there it is. A vast castle perched atop a high mountain, its windows sparkling in the starry sky, turrets and towers reflected in the glassy black lake. The first-years gasp. Even Hermione is speechless. They cross the lake in enchanted boats, passing beneath a curtain of ivy into the cliff face.
established_facts: Hogwarts is a massive medieval castle
First years cross the Black Lake by boat

choices.text: Enter the Great Hall for the Sorting Ceremony

nodes.prose: The Great Hall is lit by thousands of floating candles. The ceiling is enchanted to look like the night sky. Professor McGonagall places a battered, patched hat on a stool. The Sorting Hat sings its song about the four houses. 'Granger, Hermione!' She nearly runs to the stool. 'GRYFFINDOR!' Then 'Malfoy, Draco!' The hat barely touches his head — 'SLYTHERIN!' Neville is sorted into Gryffindor. Then: 'Potter, Harry!' The entire hall erupts in whispers.
character_states: The whole school is watching Harry
established_facts: The Sorting Hat reads minds
The ceiling reflects the sky outside

choices.text: Beg the hat: 'Not Slytherin, not Slytherin...'
Stay silent and accept the hat's choice

nodes.prose: 'Hmm, you could be great, you know. Slytherin would help you on the way to greatness...' Harry says nothing. 'SLYTHERIN!' The hall goes silent. Then Draco Malfoy starts clapping slowly. Harry walks to the Slytherin table. Ron stares at him like he's a stranger. Snape watches with a thin, cold smile. Over the years, the darkness slowly, inevitably, consumes him.
established_facts: Harry chose power over friendship

nodes.prose: 'Not Slytherin, eh?' the hat muses inside Harry's head. 'Are you sure? You could be great, you know. It's all here, in your head. And Slytherin will help you on the way to greatness, no doubt about that. No? Well, if you're sure — better be... GRYFFINDOR!' The Gryffindor table explodes. Fred and George Weasley chant, 'We got Potter! We got Potter!' Harry sits next to Ron, grinning. At the staff table, Dumbledore's eyes twinkle — and Snape stares at Harry with a look of pure loathing.
established_facts: The hat considered Slytherin for Harry
Snape despises Harry on sight

choices.text: Begin your first week of classes
Wander the castle and stumble upon the third-floor corridor

nodes.prose: The castle is bewildering — 142 staircases that move, doors that aren't really doors, and a poltergeist named Peeves. Harry learns Transfiguration from McGonagall (who turns her desk into a pig), Charms from tiny Professor Flitwick (who topples off his book stack when he reads Harry's name), and Herbology from Professor Sprout. But the class Harry dreads most is Potions, in the dungeons, with Severus Snape.
established_facts: The castle has moving staircases
Peeves is a poltergeist
Each professor teaches a specific subject

choices.text: Attend your first Potions class with Snape
Skip class and explore the Forbidden Forest edge with Hagrid

nodes.prose: 'You are here to learn the subtle science and exact art of potion-making,' Snape whispers. His voice is barely audible, but every student is frozen. 'Potter! What would I get if I added powdered root of asphodel to an infusion of wormwood?' Harry doesn't know. 'Where would you look if I told you to find me a bezoar?' Harry glances at Hermione — her hand is in the air. 'What is the difference between monkshood and wolfsbane?' 'I don't know, sir.' Snape's lip curls. 'Clearly, fame isn't everything.'
established_facts: Asphodel and wormwood make the Draught of Living Death
A bezoar is a stone from a goat's stomach that cures most poisons
Monkshood and wolfsbane are the same plant (aconite)
Snape's hatred of Harry is personal, not professional

choices.text: Head to your first flying lesson
Confront Snape after class about his hostility
Visit Hagrid's hut to complain about Snape

nodes.prose: Madam Hooch blows her whistle. 'Mount your brooms! On my whistle — three, two—' Neville kicks off too early, rising uncontrollably. He falls twenty feet, breaking his wrist. Madam Hooch rushes him to the hospital wing. Draco picks up Neville's Remembrall. 'Look what Longbottom dropped.' Harry steps forward. 'Give it here, Malfoy.' Draco smirks and rockets into the sky on his broom.
established_facts: Neville's Remembrall was a gift from his grandmother
Students were told not to fly

choices.text: Chase Draco on your broom to get the Remembrall back
Stay on the ground and report Draco

nodes.prose: You stay planted on the ground. Draco throws the Remembrall and it shatters on the courtyard stones. Draco is given detention. But McGonagall never sees you fly. You never make the Quidditch team. Without the late-night practices, you never overhear Snape threatening Quirrell, never piece together the mystery of the third-floor corridor. By June, Quirrell retrieves the Stone. Voldemort returns.
established_facts: Inaction has consequences

nodes.prose: Harry mounts his broom and shoots upward. He's never flown before — but it's instinctive, pure freedom. Draco throws the Remembrall. Harry dives — fifty feet straight down — and catches it inches from the ground. The Gryffindors roar. Then a voice: 'HARRY POTTER!' McGonagall is at the window, white-faced. Harry's stomach drops. But instead of expelling him, she marches him to Oliver Wood. 'Wood, I've found you a Seeker.'
character_states: Harry is the youngest Seeker in a century
established_facts: Harry is a natural on a broomstick
Harry is now on the Gryffindor Quidditch team
First-years normally aren't allowed brooms

choices.text: Discover the forbidden third-floor corridor
Focus on Quidditch practice for the upcoming match
Visit Hagrid to celebrate making the team

nodes.prose: That night, Draco challenges Harry to a midnight wizard's duel in the trophy room. It's a trick — Filch is waiting. Running from the caretaker, Harry, Ron, Hermione, and Neville accidentally stumble through a locked door on the third-floor corridor. They come face to face with a monstrous three-headed dog standing on a trapdoor. All three heads snarl. They slam the door and run. 'What do they think they're doing, keeping a thing like that locked up in a school?' Ron gasps. Hermione's eyes narrow. 'Didn't you see what it was standing on? A trapdoor. It's guarding something.'
character_states: Harry, Ron, Hermione, and Neville found Fluffy
established_facts: A three-headed dog guards a trapdoor on the third floor
Dumbledore warned students that the corridor was forbidden on pain of death
The dog belongs to Hagrid — its name is Fluffy

choices.text: Let Halloween arrive
Take a shortcut back through the fourth-floor corridor

nodes.prose: On Halloween, Professor Flitwick teaches the levitation charm. 'Wingardium Leviosa!' Ron flicks his wand wildly. 'You're saying it wrong,' Hermione corrects him. 'It's Levi-O-sa, not Levio-SA.' Ron mocks her afterward: 'It's Levi-O-sa, not Levio-SA. She's a nightmare, honestly.' Hermione hears him. She spends the rest of the afternoon crying in the girls' bathroom. At the Halloween feast, Quirrell bursts through the doors, turban askew. 'TROLL! IN THE DUNGEON! Thought you ought to know.' He faints.
character_states: Hermione is alone in the bathroom
established_facts: Hermione is upset and isolated
A mountain troll has entered Hogwarts
Quirrell let the troll in as a diversion

choices.text: Rush to warn Hermione about the troll
Follow Snape — he's not going to the dungeons

nodes.prose: You follow Snape. He's heading toward the third-floor corridor, not the dungeons. He slips through the forbidden door. Minutes later he emerges, limping badly, his robes torn. Blood seeps from a deep bite wound on his leg. He mutters about the 'blasted beast' and limps away. Now you know — Snape tried to get past Fluffy. He must be after whatever the three-headed dog is guarding.
character_states: Harry suspects Snape is trying to steal the protected object
established_facts: Snape was bitten by Fluffy
Snape went to the third floor during the troll diversion

choices.text: But Hermione is still in the bathroom with the troll!

nodes.prose: The mountain troll has found Hermione. It's twelve feet tall, skin like granite, dragging a massive club. Hermione screams. Harry jumps on its back and shoves his wand up its nose. Ron pulls out his wand — 'Wingardium Leviosa!' — and levitates the troll's own club above its head. It drops with a sickening crack. The troll crumples. McGonagall arrives: 'Explain yourselves!' Hermione lies for the first time: 'I went looking for the troll. I thought I could handle it. If Harry and Ron hadn't come, I'd be dead.'
character_states: The Golden Trio is officially formed
established_facts: Ron performed Wingardium Leviosa perfectly under pressure
Hermione is now friends with Harry and Ron
There are some things you can't share without ending up liking each other

choices.text: Play your first Quidditch match
Research what the three-headed dog is guarding
Tell Hagrid about the troll incident

nodes.prose: Harry's first Quidditch match: Gryffindor vs Slytherin. Harry spots the Golden Snitch but his broom suddenly bucks and jerks wildly, trying to throw him off. In the stands, Hermione spots Snape muttering, his eyes locked on Harry — a jinx! She creeps behind the stands and sets Snape's robes on fire with a bluebell flame. In the confusion, she also knocks over Quirrell. Harry's broom steadies. He dives, catches the Snitch in his mouth, and nearly swallows it. Gryffindor wins 170-60.
character_states: Harry believes Snape jinxed his broom
established_facts: Someone was jinxing Harry's broom
Hermione accidentally broke Quirrell's eye contact too
The real jinxer was Quirrell — Snape was performing the counter-curse

choices.text: Visit Hagrid and discover Nicolas Flamel
Sneak to the library to research the broom jinx
Wait for Christmas break to investigate freely

nodes.prose: Harry, Ron, and Hermione confront Hagrid. 'Snape tried to kill me!' Hagrid scoffs. 'Snape? He's a Hogwarts teacher!' They press him. 'Who else knows how to get past Fluffy?' 'Well, I lent Fluffy to Dumbledore to guard the— I shouldn' have said that. Don' ask me anymore.' When they mention the package from Vault 713, Hagrid goes pale. 'That's between Dumbledore and Nicolas Flamel.' He claps his hand over his mouth. 'I should NOT have said that.'
character_states: Hagrid accidentally revealed Nicolas Flamel's name
The trio now has a lead
established_facts: Nicolas Flamel is connected to whatever Fluffy is guarding
The package from Vault 713 is under Fluffy's trapdoor
Hagrid is terrible at keeping secrets

choices.text: Christmas arrives at Hogwarts
Research Nicolas Flamel in the library immediately
Confront Snape about the third-floor corridor

nodes.prose: Harry stays at Hogwarts for Christmas — his first real Christmas ever. He wakes to presents at the foot of his bed. Mrs. Weasley knitted him a jumper. Hagrid carved him a flute. But one gift has no card: a shimmering, silvery cloak that flows like water. A note reads: 'Your father left this in my possession before he died. Use it well.' It's an Invisibility Cloak. Harry drapes it over himself and vanishes entirely.
character_states: Harry received his first Christmas presents
established_facts: The cloak belonged to James Potter
Dumbledore sent the cloak anonymously
The Invisibility Cloak is one of the three Deathly Hallows

choices.text: Use the cloak to sneak into the Restricted Section of the library
Use the cloak to break into Snape's office for evidence

nodes.prose: Sneaking through the library at night, Harry ducks into an unused classroom to avoid Filch. There, he finds an enormous mirror with the inscription: 'Erised stra ehru oyt ube cafru oyt on wohsi.' He looks into it and gasps — his mother and father are standing behind him, smiling and waving. He reaches back — but there's nobody there. He returns night after night, sitting before the mirror for hours, watching his dead parents.
character_states: Harry is obsessed with the mirror
Harry sees his deepest desire: his family
established_facts: The Mirror of Erised shows the deepest desire of the viewer's heart
The inscription reads backwards: 'I show not your face but your heart's desire'
Dumbledore sees himself holding thick woolen socks

choices.text: Dumbledore finds Harry at the mirror

nodes.prose: 'So — back again, Harry?' Dumbledore sits in a desk behind him. 'The Mirror of Erised shows us nothing more or less than the deepest, most desperate desire of our hearts. You, who have never known your family, see them standing around you. But this mirror gives us neither knowledge nor truth. Men have wasted away before it, not knowing if what they see is real. It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live. The mirror will be moved to a new home tomorrow. I ask you not to go looking for it again.'
character_states: Harry must learn to let go
established_facts: The mirror will be moved
The happiest man on earth would see only himself in the mirror
Dumbledore recognizes Harry's loneliness

choices.text: Research Nicolas Flamel in the library
Skip ahead — exams are coming and the Stone is in danger
Ask Hagrid what Dumbledore is hiding

nodes.prose: Hermione slams a book on the table. 'I checked this out weeks ago for a bit of light reading.' The book is enormous. She reads: 'Nicolas Flamel is the only known maker of the Philosopher's Stone. The Stone produces the Elixir of Life, which will make the drinker immortal. Mr. Flamel, who celebrated his 665th birthday last year, lives quietly in Devon with his wife Perenelle, 658.' The trio stares at each other. That's what Fluffy is guarding. That's what Snape wants.
character_states: The trio knows the Stone's identity
They believe Snape wants it for Voldemort
established_facts: The Philosopher's Stone creates the Elixir of Life
Nicolas Flamel is over 665 years old
The Stone is hidden at Hogwarts under multiple protections

choices.text: Visit Hagrid — he's harbouring a dragon egg
Tell Dumbledore immediately about the Stone
Sneak to the third-floor corridor for more clues

nodes.prose: Hagrid has won a dragon egg in a card game at the pub. It hatches in his wooden hut — a Norwegian Ridgeback. 'Isn't he beautiful?' Hagrid coos, as the dragon sets his beard on fire. 'I've decided to call him Norbert.' But Draco sees the dragon through the window. They must get rid of it before Hagrid is arrested. Ron's brother Charlie works with dragons in Romania — they arrange a midnight handoff on the Astronomy Tower.
character_states: Hagrid is keeping an illegal dragon
established_facts: Dragon-breeding is illegal
The stranger who gave Hagrid the egg asked about Fluffy
Hagrid told the stranger that music puts Fluffy to sleep

choices.text: Deliver Norbert to Charlie's friends on the tower

nodes.prose: Harry and Hermione smuggle Norbert under the Invisibility Cloak to the top of the Astronomy Tower. Charlie's friends whisk the dragon away into the starlit sky. But they left the cloak upstairs. Filch catches them on the way down. McGonagall is waiting — along with Neville, who tried to warn them. Detention. 150 points from Gryffindor. Harry goes from hero to pariah overnight. Even the other Gryffindors despise him.
character_states: Harry, Hermione, and Neville have detention
established_facts: The Invisibility Cloak was left behind
Harry, Hermione, and Neville were caught
Draco was also caught and got detention

choices.text: Serve detention in the Forbidden Forest
Skip detention and rush straight to the trapdoor

nodes.prose: For detention, Hagrid takes them into the Forbidden Forest at night. Something has been killing unicorns and drinking their blood. They split up. Harry and Draco find a dead unicorn in a clearing — and a hooded figure crawling toward it, drinking the silver blood. The figure raises its head. Harry's scar explodes with pain. A centaur named Firenze bursts from the trees, scattering the creature. 'Harry Potter, do you know what unicorn blood is used for?' 'No.' 'It will keep you alive, even if you are an inch from death. But at a terrible price. You have slain something pure and defenseless to save yourself.'
established_facts: Something is drinking unicorn blood to survive
Unicorn blood sustains life but curses the drinker
The hooded figure is Voldemort
Voldemort wants the Stone to restore his body

choices.text: Realize the Stone is in danger and confront the final challenge
Go directly through the trapdoor now
Ask Hagrid about who gave him the dragon egg

nodes.prose: Exams pass. Harry's scar keeps burning. He suddenly realizes: the stranger who gave Hagrid the dragon egg — Hagrid told him how to get past Fluffy! 'He just has ter play a bit o' music and Fluffy falls straight asleep,' Hagrid admits. They rush to tell Dumbledore, but McGonagall says he's been called away to the Ministry by urgent owl. Harry goes cold. 'It's tonight. Snape's going through the trapdoor tonight.'
character_states: Harry knows someone is going for the Stone tonight
established_facts: Music puts Fluffy to sleep
Dumbledore was called to London
The owl was a fake — it was a trick to remove Dumbledore

choices.text: Go through the trapdoor tonight
Wait for Dumbledore to return

nodes.prose: You wait for Dumbledore. By the time he returns the next morning, Quirrell has already retrieved the Stone from the Mirror of Erised. Voldemort's parasitic form has consumed the Elixir. The Dark Lord rises again from Quirrell's body. Hogwarts falls before the school year ends.
established_facts: Hesitation cost everything

nodes.prose: That night, they sneak past Neville (Hermione petrifies him with a tearful 'Petrificus Totalus'), past the harp already playing for Fluffy (someone's already been here), and jump through the trapdoor into darkness. They land on something soft, squishy, and alive.
character_states: Harry, Ron, and Hermione are beneath the trapdoor
established_facts: Neville tried to stop them
Fluffy was already asleep — someone else played music

choices.text: Fight the Devil's Snare

nodes.prose: The plant wraps around them, tightening with every struggle. 'Stop moving!' Hermione yells. 'It's Devil's Snare — it'll only kill you faster if you struggle!' Ron panics. 'Oh, lucky we're not panicking!' Hermione remembers: Devil's Snare hates light. 'Lumos Solem!' A jet of sunlight bursts from her wand. The plant recoils and they drop to the stone floor below.
character_states: Hermione saved them with a sunlight spell
established_facts: Devil's Snare is Professor Sprout's protection
It hates sunlight and warmth
Each teacher contributed one protection for the Stone

choices.text: Enter the chamber of flying keys

nodes.prose: They enter a chamber full of hundreds of jewel-bright birds — except they're not birds. They're enchanted, winged keys, fluttering around the vaulted ceiling. A heavy locked door blocks the way. A broomstick hovers in the center. Harry mounts it and shoots into the swarm. He spots it — an old, silver key with a bent wing, as though it's already been caught and stuffed roughly back. He dives, snatches it, and throws it to Hermione. She jams it in the lock.
character_states: Harry used his Seeker skills to catch the right key
established_facts: This was Professor Flitwick's protection
The key had a crumpled wing — it had been used before

choices.text: Cross the giant wizard chess board

nodes.prose: A full-size wizard chess set blocks their path. The pieces are alive, towering, and violent. Ron takes command — chess is the one thing he's brilliant at. He plays as a knight. The game is brutal. Stone pieces smash each other to rubble. Finally, Ron sees the winning move. 'I've got to be taken. Then you're free to checkmate the king.' 'NO!' Harry and Hermione shout. 'That's chess!' Ron snaps. 'You've got to make some sacrifices!' He moves forward. The white queen drags him from his horse and strikes him across the head. Ron crumples. Harry checkmates the king. They rush on.
character_states: Ron sacrificed himself for the mission
established_facts: This was McGonagall's protection
Ron played the best chess game Hogwarts has ever seen

choices.text: Pass through Snape's potion riddle

nodes.prose: A table of seven potion bottles and a scroll of logic. Purple fire blocks the way forward; black fire blocks the way back. Hermione reads the riddle. 'This isn't magic — it's logic — a puzzle. A lot of the greatest wizards haven't got an ounce of logic.' She works it out: the smallest bottle will take Harry forward. There's only enough for one. 'You're a great wizard, Harry,' she says, eyes bright. 'Me? Books and cleverness. There are more important things. Friendship and bravery and — oh, Harry, be careful!'
character_states: Hermione stays behind to get Ron out
established_facts: This was Snape's protection
The puzzle requires logic, not magic
Only one person can go forward

choices.text: Step through the flames alone to face whoever is there

nodes.prose: Harry steps through the black flames into the final chamber. But it's not Snape standing before the Mirror of Erised. It's Quirrell. His stutter is gone. His eyes are hard. 'You!' Harry gasps. Quirrell smiles coldly. 'Yes, me. I wondered whether I'd be meeting you here, Potter. Snape does seem the type, doesn't he? Next to me, who would suspect p-p-poor, st-stuttering Professor Quirrell?'
character_states: Quirrell was the villain all along
established_facts: Quirrell faked his stutter
Snape was performing the counter-curse at Quidditch
Quirrell let the troll in to create a diversion

choices.text: Watch Quirrell try to use the Mirror

nodes.prose: Quirrell stares into the Mirror of Erised but sees only himself presenting the Stone to his master. He can't figure out how to get it out. Then a voice — high, cold — whispers from beneath Quirrell's turban: 'Use the boy.' Quirrell snaps his fingers and ropes bind Harry. 'Come here, Potter. Tell me what you see.' Harry looks into the mirror. He sees himself — and his reflection winks, pulls the blood-red Stone from its pocket, and drops it into Harry's pocket. Harry feels the weight. He lies: 'I... I see myself shaking hands with Dumbledore. I've won the House Cup.'
character_states: Harry has the Stone in his pocket
established_facts: Only someone who wanted to find the Stone but not use it could get it from the Mirror
This was Dumbledore's final protection
The voice is Voldemort

choices.text: Voldemort reveals himself

nodes.prose: 'He lies,' the voice hisses. 'Let me speak to him... face to face.' Quirrell slowly unwraps his turban. Harry stares in horror. Where there should be a back of Quirrell's head, there is a face — chalk-white with glaring red eyes and slits for nostrils. Lord Voldemort. 'See what I have become?' the face whispers. 'Mere shadow and vapor. I have form only when I can share another's body. Unicorn blood has sustained me, but it cannot give me a body of my own. But there is something that can. Something that, conveniently enough, lies in your pocket.'
character_states: Voldemort is parasitically attached to Quirrell's head
Harry is face to face with his parents' killer
established_facts: Voldemort has been living on the back of Quirrell's head all year
The turban hid Voldemort
Voldemort wants the Stone to create a new body

choices.text: Refuse to give Voldemort the Stone
Hand over the Stone out of fear

nodes.prose: Trembling, you hold out the Stone. Quirrell snatches it. Voldemort laughs — a terrible, high sound. The Elixir of Life is brewed within hours. Voldemort rises again, more terrible than before. Dumbledore arrives too late. The Dark Lord returns in Harry's first year. Everything that follows is darkness.
established_facts: Fear conquered courage

nodes.prose: 'SEIZE HIM!' Voldemort screams. Quirrell lunges and wraps his hands around Harry's throat. Harry's scar screams with agony — but Quirrell recoils, howling. His hands are blistering, burning, crumbling as if made of ember. Harry grabs Quirrell's face and holds on. Quirrell shrieks. His skin cracks and flakes into ash. The protection Lily Potter placed on Harry with her sacrifice — her love — is burning Voldemort's vessel alive. A wraith-like shadow rips from Quirrell's crumbling body and passes through Harry with a shriek. Everything goes black.
established_facts: Lily's sacrifice created a love-based protection in Harry's blood
Voldemort cannot touch Harry without being burned
Love is the most powerful magic

choices.text: Wake up in the Hospital Wing

nodes.prose: Harry wakes in blinding white light. He's in the Hospital Wing. Dumbledore sits beside his bed, smiling gently. Every surface is covered in sweets from admirers. 'What happened to the Stone?' Harry asks. 'It has been destroyed. Nicolas Flamel and I had a little chat. He agreed it was for the best.' Harry is stunned. 'But that means he'll die?' 'To the well-organized mind, death is but the next great adventure,' Dumbledore says softly.
character_states: Dumbledore is being cryptic and wise
established_facts: The Stone was destroyed
Nicolas Flamel will die
Dumbledore arrived just in time

choices.text: Ask Dumbledore why Voldemort couldn't touch you

nodes.prose: 'Your mother died to save you. If there is one thing Voldemort cannot understand, it is love. He didn't realize that a love as powerful as your mother's for you leaves its own mark. Not a scar, no visible sign... to have been loved so deeply, even though the person who loved us is gone, will give us some protection forever.' Harry's eyes sting. 'And sir, one more thing — why does Professor Snape hate me so much?' Dumbledore pauses. 'He and your father... rather detested each other. Not unlike yourself and Mr. Malfoy. And then your father did something Snape could never forgive.' 'What?' 'He saved his life.'
character_states: Harry understands love is the deepest magic
Dumbledore is hiding something about Snape
established_facts: Lily's love protects Harry physically
Snape hated James Potter
Snape owes a life-debt to James
There is far more to Snape's story than Harry knows

choices.text: Attend the end-of-year feast

nodes.prose: The Great Hall is decorated in Slytherin green and silver — they've won the House Cup. Then Dumbledore stands. 'I have a few last-minute points to dish out.' To Ron Weasley: 50 points for the best-played game of chess Hogwarts has seen. To Hermione Granger: 50 points for the use of cool logic in the face of fire. To Harry Potter: 60 points for pure nerve and outstanding courage. Gryffindor ties Slytherin. Then: 'It takes a great deal of bravery to stand up to our enemies, but just as much to stand up to our friends. I therefore award 10 points to Mr. Neville Longbottom.'
character_states: Neville is in tears of joy
established_facts: Dumbledore awarded 170 last-minute points
Neville earned the final, deciding points
The decorations change from green to scarlet and gold

choices.text: Board the Hogwarts Express home

nodes.prose: The Hogwarts Express rolls through the countryside. Exam results came — even Neville passed. Harry gives Ron and Hermione his phone number (Ron has no idea what a telephone is). At King's Cross, Hagrid is waiting. He hands Harry a leather-bound photo album full of pictures of his parents — smiling, waving, holding baby Harry. 'Sent owls around to all yer parents' old school friends, askin' fer photos. Knew yeh didn't have any.' Harry's eyes fill with tears. The Dursleys are waiting, looking horrified. 'They don't know we're not allowed to use magic at home,' Harry grins at Ron. 'I'm going to have a lot of fun with Dudley this summer.'
character_states: Harry has a photo album of his parents
Harry returns to Privet Drive with friends for the first time
Harry is already looking forward to returning to Hogwarts
established_facts: Harry survived his first year
Voldemort is still out there
Harry has found his home at Hogwarts
The adventure is only beginning

nodes.prose: You take a shortcut through the fourth-floor corridor. Peeves swoops down cackling, pelting you with water balloons and chalk. He seals the corridor doors with a jinx he stole from a seventh-year. You pound on the door, but nobody comes. You're stuck here until morning, shivering and soaked. By then, whatever was happening on the third floor is long over.
established_facts: Peeves sealed the corridor
Hours were wasted

nodes.prose: You sneak into Snape's office to find evidence that he's after the Stone. His shelves are lined with pickled things in jars. You find a piece of parchment referencing 'the Dark Lord's return.' Suddenly, the door clicks shut. Snape stands in the doorway, his black eyes glittering. 'Well, well, well. Breaking into a teacher's private office. Your father would be so proud.' He confiscates your Invisibility Cloak. You are expelled the next morning.
established_facts: Harry broke into Snape's office
Harry is expelled from Hogwarts

nodes.prose: In the summer of 1899, a young Albus Dumbledore met Gellert Grindelwald in Godric's Hollow. Two brilliant minds, consumed by the idea of wizard supremacy and the Deathly Hallows. They made plans to find the three legendary artifacts — the Elder Wand, the Resurrection Stone, and the Cloak of Invisibility — and rule over Muggles 'for the greater good.'
character_states: Young Dumbledore was ambitious and dangerous
established_facts: Dumbledore and Grindelwald were once close friends
The Deathly Hallows are real artifacts
The Invisibility Cloak Harry owns is one of the three Hallows

choices.text: Learn about the duel that ended their friendship

nodes.prose: A three-way duel erupted between Albus, his brother Aberforth, and Grindelwald. In the crossfire, a stray curse struck Ariana Dumbledore — Albus's younger sister. She died instantly. Dumbledore never forgave himself. This is why, decades later, when he looks in the Mirror of Erised, he does not see socks. He sees his family, whole and unbroken.
established_facts: Dumbledore's deepest desire is his family
He lied to Harry about the socks
Grindelwald fled after Ariana's death

nodes.prose: Years before Harry arrived at Hogwarts, Hagrid won Fluffy in a card game at a pub in Greece. The three-headed dog was a puppy then — barely the size of a horse. 'He was jus' a little fella,' Hagrid recalls fondly. 'Used ter sleep on me bed.' By the time Dumbledore needed a guardian for the Stone, Fluffy filled an entire corridor.
established_facts: Hagrid won Fluffy in a card game in Greece
Fluffy grew to fill an entire corridor

choices.text: Learn how Fluffy responds to music

nodes.prose: Hagrid discovered by accident that all three of Fluffy's heads would droop simultaneously when he played his wooden flute — the same flute he later carved for Harry as a Christmas present. 'Any sort o' music puts him right out,' Hagrid told the stranger in the pub. He didn't realize the stranger in the hooded cloak was Professor Quirrell, gathering intelligence for Voldemort.
character_states: The stranger was Quirrell in disguise
established_facts: Music puts Fluffy to sleep
Quirrell manipulated Hagrid
The flute Hagrid gave Harry is the same one he used on Fluffy
